entities.summary: Rutilio Cruz Escandón Cadenas is a Mexican lawyer and politician from Chiapas. He is affiliated with MORENA and was the Governor of Chiapas from 2018 to 2024. Before becoming governor, he represented Chiapas as a senator of the LVIII and LIX and as a federal deputy in the LX Legislature. Rutilio Escandón was a legal figures from Venustiano Carranza Municipality (b. 1958-05-03, Venustiano Carranza Municipality). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
